string.name: text
string.value: Even without a Seal Stone, you knew you couldn't give up on Maple Island.

string.name: text
string.value: As you and the others rebuilt Maple Island, brick by brick, a darkness crept back toward the island.

string.name: text
string.value: It was as dark as night, but you recognized it... the Black Mage's Shadow.

string.name: text
string.value: His shadow held but a fraction of the Black Mage's true powers...

string.name: text
string.value: ...yet not even your most powerful strikes could maim it.

string.name: text
string.value: The others grew weary, as you fought futilely. The end was nigh.

string.name: text
string.value: Your friends poured the last of their strength into you. You knew it wouldn't be enough, but you were determined to try. Suddenly, a mystic glow poured out of you and a Maple Leaf floated before your eyes.
